paragraphs.source_en: Taking up the sake gourd, Chōan filled an inlaid mother-of-pearl cup with a gurgle and drained two cups in succession. After filling a third, he set it on the felt and merely stared into space, as though he had utterly lost all sense of time.

units.source_zh: 第三杯倒满后被搁在毡上，他只是发呆，仿佛浑然忘了今夕何夕。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安拿着酒瓢，朝青贝酒盏里咕嘟咕嘟倒满酒，连饮了两杯。第三杯倒满后被搁在毡上，他只是发呆，仿佛浑然忘了今夕何夕。

paragraphs.source_en: Many visitors had come during the days Chōan remained in charge of Sumpu. Sotelo, who had come expressly from the dispensary in Asakusa, Edo, brought him the most unwelcome news of all—the shogun Hidetada was watching him. The chief reason was the Spaniard Vizcaíno, who was then conducting surveys in various places.

units.source_en: Many visitors had come during the days Chōan remained in charge of Sumpu.
units.source_zh: 长安留守骏府这些日子，来了不少客人。

units.source_en: Sotelo, who had come expressly from the dispensary in Asakusa, Edo, brought him the most unwelcome news of all—the shogun Hidetada was watching him.

ja.t: をつけているというのだ。

units.source_zh: 特意从江户浅草施药院赶来的索德罗告知他一件最令人不快之事——将军秀忠正在盯着他！

units.source_en: The chief reason was the Spaniard Vizcaíno, who was then conducting surveys in various places.
units.source_zh: 最大的原因，便是目前在四处探测的班国人比斯卡伊诺。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安留守骏府这些日子，来了不少客人。特意从江户浅草施药院赶来的索德罗告知他一件最令人不快之事——将军秀忠正在盯着他！最大的原因，便是目前在四处探测的班国人比斯卡伊诺。

paragraphs.source_en: Sotelo had come to Sumpu the previous autumn to see Ieyasu, then visited the shogun Hidetada in Edo, and was now staying at Uraga. He had met Vizcaíno and witnessed the man’s ridiculous ambition.

units.source_en: Sotelo had come to Sumpu the previous autumn to see Ieyasu, then visited the shogun Hidetada in Edo, and was now staying at Uraga.
units.source_zh: 索德罗去岁秋到骏府见了家康，然后到江户拜访将军秀忠，现正逗留浦贺。

units.source_en: He had met Vizcaíno and witnessed the man’s ridiculous ambition.
units.source_zh: 他曾与比斯卡伊诺相见，见识过此人那可笑的野心。

paragraphs.source_zh: 索德罗去岁秋到骏府见了家康，然后到江户拜访将军秀忠，现正逗留浦贺。他曾与比斯卡伊诺相见，见识过此人那可笑的野心。

paragraphs.source_en: “General Vizcaíno has no intention whatever of returning to Mexico.” Sotelo said, “That is why he keeps inventing excuses to delay, carefully surveying the waters around Japan in search of the Isles of Gold. It is a wicked deed the Lord cannot permit.”

units.source_en: “General Vizcaíno has no intention whatever of returning to Mexico.”
units.source_zh: “比斯卡伊诺将军根本不欲回墨国。”

units.source_en: Sotelo said, “That is why he keeps inventing excuses to delay, carefully surveying the waters around Japan in search of the Isles of Gold.
units.source_zh: 索德罗道，“他才找借口拖延时日，在日本近海仔细探测，寻找黄金岛。

units.source_en: It is a wicked deed the Lord cannot permit.”
units.source_zh: 这是主所不允许的恶行。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “比斯卡伊诺将军根本不欲回墨国。”索德罗道，“他才找借口拖延时日，在日本近海仔细探测，寻找黄金岛。这是主所不允许的恶行。”

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan had also seen through Sotelo’s thoughts: he aspired to become archbishop of the East, and nowhere in the world inflamed his ambition as Japan did.

units.source_en: Chōan had also seen through Sotelo’s thoughts: he aspired to become archbishop of the East, and nowhere in the world inflamed his ambition as Japan did.
units.source_zh: 长安也看透了索德罗的所思所想：他希望做东洋大主教，世上没有一个地方像日本这样，令他野心膨胀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长安也看透了索德罗的所思所想：他希望做东洋大主教，世上没有一个地方像日本这样，令他野心膨胀。

paragraphs.source_en: “What an awe-inspiring holy man you are! What counsel has the holy man for Chōan?”

units.source_en: “What an awe-inspiring holy man you are!
units.source_zh: “真是让人敬畏的圣人啊！

units.source_en: What counsel has the holy man for Chōan?”
units.source_zh: 圣人对长安有何指教？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “真是让人敬畏的圣人啊！圣人对长安有何指教？”

paragraphs.source_en: Without changing expression, Sotelo named two things. First, Honda Masazumi must be brought down as soon as possible. Andō Naotsugu, as Yorinobu’s close retainer, had lately become estranged from the shogun. Honda Masazumi, however, was certain to win Hidetada’s favor. With his hand never more than five inches from the weighty sword hilt of authority, his power would only grow; Sotelo and Chōan must strike first.

units.source_en: Without changing expression, Sotelo named two things. First, Honda Masazumi must be brought down as soon as possible.
units.source_zh: 索德罗面不改色说了两点：其一，尽快扳倒本多正纯。

units.source_en: Andō Naotsugu, as Yorinobu’s close retainer, had lately become estranged from the shogun.
units.source_zh: 安藤直次作为赖宣的贴身家老，近来受到将军疏远。

units.source_en: Honda Masazumi, however, was certain to win Hidetada’s favor. With his hand never more than five inches from the weighty sword hilt of authority, his power would only grow; Sotelo and Chōan must strike first.
units.source_zh: 但本多正纯定会被秀忠亲近，他身不离重柄五寸，权力自会越来越大，索德罗和长安必须先发制人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 索德罗面不改色说了两点：其一，尽快扳倒本多正纯。安藤直次作为赖宣的贴身家老，近来受到将军疏远。但本多正纯定会被秀忠亲近，他身不离重柄五寸，权力自会越来越大，索德罗和长安必须先发制人。

paragraphs.source_en: “And the second?”

units.source_en: “And the second?”
units.source_zh: “第二是什么？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “第二是什么？”

paragraphs.source_en: “It is difficult for me to refuse General Vizcaíno. Therefore, should the secret of the sunken ship ever come to light, I ask you, my lord, to show me a way of escape.”

units.source_en: “It is difficult for me to refuse General Vizcaíno.
units.source_zh: “鄙人很难拒绝比斯卡伊诺将军。

units.source_en: Therefore, should the secret of the sunken ship ever come to light, I ask you, my lord, to show me a way of escape.”
units.source_zh: 故万一沉船的秘密泄露出去，想请大人指点鄙人脱身之策。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “鄙人很难拒绝比斯卡伊诺将军。故万一沉船的秘密泄露出去，想请大人指点鄙人脱身之策。”

paragraphs.source_en: There was a threat in those words—if you leave me no road to safety, I can drive you to ruin as well… Hearing this from Sotelo, Chōan was stunned.

units.source_en: There was a threat in those words—if you leave me no road to safety, I can drive you to ruin as well… Hearing this from Sotelo, Chōan was stunned.

paragraphs.source_zh: 其中有威胁的意味——你若不给我生路，我也能令你走上绝途……听索德罗这样一说，长安呆住。

paragraphs.source_en: Sotelo could no longer be moved by either threats or persuasion. The dispensary he had established in Asakusa had originally treated only the lowborn, but as Western medicine and remedies gradually gained acceptance, even daimyos now sought treatment there. Consequently, he had many sources of information and could not be left unguarded against.

units.source_en: Sotelo could no longer be moved by either threats or persuasion.
units.source_zh: 如今的索德罗软硬不吃。

units.source_en: The dispensary he had established in Asakusa had originally treated only the lowborn, but as Western medicine and remedies gradually gained acceptance, even daimyos now sought treatment there.
units.source_zh: 他在浅草修建的施药院，最初只为贱民看病，但随着洋医与洋药逐渐被世间认可，现在连大名也去找他们瞧病。

paragraphs.source_en: “Very well. I shall tell you what to do.” Chōan nodded readily.

paragraphs.source_zh: “好。我就告诉你该怎么办。”长安爽快地点点头。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Iwami-no-kami is indeed a wise man, with the gifts of a chief minister.” Sotelo flattered him.

units.source_en: “Lord Iwami-no-kami is indeed a wise man, with the gifts of a chief minister.”
units.source_zh: “石见守大人果然智者，有宰相之才。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “石见守大人果然智者，有宰相之才。”索德罗恭维道。

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh?”

units.source_en: “Oh?”

paragraphs.source_en: “When that happens, however, you will no longer be able to remain in Edo. You may have to stay for a time at the Date residence and preach in Sendai for the meanwhile. But a man of your caliber hardly needs such a warning!”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不过，那时你就不能待在江户了，说不定得暂时住到伊达府上，就暂且在仙台传教吧。其实无须这样的提醒，你是何等人物！”

paragraphs.source_en: Sotelo seemed relieved. Leaving behind the bread and other gifts he had brought, he returned to Edo.

units.source_en: Sotelo seemed relieved. Leaving behind the bread and other gifts he had brought, he returned to Edo.

paragraphs.source_en: How could Honda Masazumi be brought down? The question lingered in Chōan’s mind for a long time. Peace had come to the realm, yet not all enemies had been destroyed. Unlike enemies faced with naked steel on the battlefield, new enemies who wielded no weapons were drawing ever closer. Honda Sado-no-kami was rumored to be at odds with Ōkubo Tadachika; naturally, there were also rumors of discord between Sado-no-kami’s son Masazumi and Chōan, who had entered service through Tadachika’s patronage. As Sotelo had said, he must devise a way to bring Honda down without delay.

units.source_en: How could Honda Masazumi be brought down?

units.source_en: Honda Sado-no-kami was rumored to be at odds with Ōkubo Tadachika; naturally, there were also rumors of discord between Sado-no-kami’s son Masazumi and Chōan, who had entered service through Tadachika’s patronage.

paragraphs.source_zh: 如何才能扳倒本多正纯？这个问题久久萦绕在长安心中。天下太平了，敌人却未全部灭绝。比起在战场上真刀真枪，不动刀枪的新敌人正越走越近。传言本多佐渡守和大久保忠邻不和，佐渡守之子正纯和受忠邻提携得以出仕的长安，自然也有了不和的传闻。如索德罗所言，必须尽快想出扳倒本多的办法。

paragraphs.source_en: Chōan had troubles of his own: several veins that were still yielding ore had been closed by the shogunate on the grounds that they “produced neither gold nor silver,” while the true output of certain other mines had not been reported.

paragraphs.source_en: As though he had read Chōan’s thoughts, the man managing affairs in Masazumi’s absence came to visit at that very moment. His name was Matsuo Matsujūrō. He knew of certain unspeakable dealings involving Okamoto Daihachi, one of Masazumi’s men, and had once offered to sell the information to Chōan for ten ingots of gold. Chōan had naturally berated him and driven him away, fearing it was a trap laid by the other side. Yet Matsujūrō had come again today.
